data: Did the performance of all models increase after the corrections were made?

Wait a moment, let me verify this. The caption mentions that the figure shows the performance of CoNLL-2005 models after applying corrections from He et al. (2017). Looking at the graph, I can see multiple lines representing different models. The baseline model appears to have improved its performance after the corrections, as indicated by the upward trend in its line. Similarly, other models like Gold, Gold w/o LSTM, SpanGCN, and SpanGCN w/o LSTM also show an improvement in their performance after the corrections. Therefore, it seems that the performance of all models increased after the corrections were made.
Yes, the performance of all models increased after the corrections were made.
